```{r Step 0: Ingest Data, include=TRUE}
analysis_data <- read_csv(here("01_tidydata", "metrotabledata.csv"))
```

```{r Step 1: Data Preprocessing - Set up Index and PCA, include=TRUE}
analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(log_employment_density = log(total_employment_density))

analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(employment_density_z = scale(log_employment_density))

analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(employment_density_z = as.numeric(employment_density_z))

analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(log_housing_density = log(housing_density))


analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(
    H_z = as.numeric(scale(log(housing_density))),
    E_z = as.numeric(scale(log(total_employment_density))),
    D_z = as.numeric(scale(industry_diversity)),
    
    agglo_index = (H_z + E_z + D_z) / 3
  )

analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(pca_complete = complete.cases(H_z, E_z, D_z))

analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(
    PC1 = NA_real_,
    PC2 = NA_real_
  )

analysis_data$PC1[analysis_data$pca_complete] <- as.numeric(scale(pca$x[,1]))
analysis_data$PC2[analysis_data$pca_complete] <- as.numeric(scale(pca$x[,2]))

analysis_data %>%
  select(H_z, E_z, D_z) %>%
  cor(use = "complete.obs")

pca_input <- analysis_data %>%
  select(H_z, E_z, D_z) %>%
  drop_na()

pca <- prcomp(pca_input, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)

pca$rotation


```


```{r Step 2: Main Fixed Effects Principal Components Model, include=TRUE}
model_pca_fe <- feols(
  cost_burdened ~ PC1 + PC2 | GEOID + year,
  data = analysis_data
)

summary(model_pca_fe)

model_nonlinear <- feols(
  cost_burdened ~ PC1 + I(PC1^2) + PC2 | GEOID + year,
  data = analysis_data
)

summary(model_nonlinear)

#Plotting Implied Effect of PC1 
analysis_complete <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(PC1))

pc1_seq <- seq(
  min(analysis_complete$PC1),
  max(analysis_complete$PC1),
  length.out = 100
)

pc1_seq <- seq(min(analysis_data$PC1), max(analysis_data$PC1), length.out = 100)

pred <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pc1_seq,
  PC2 = 0
)

pred$yhat <- coef(model_nonlinear)["PC1"] * pred$PC1 +
             coef(model_nonlinear)["I(I(PC1^2))"] * pred$PC1^2

ggplot(pred, aes(PC1, yhat)) +
  geom_line()


#Analysis with Urban Density Frontloaded
analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(
    urban_density = (H_z + E_z) / 2
  )

model_pcareplace <- feols(
  cost_burdened ~ urban_density + D_z + I(urban_density^2) | GEOID + year,
  data = analysis_data
)

summary(model_pcareplace)
```

```{r Step 2: Main Model, include=TRUE}
# sequence of urban density values
x_seq <- seq(
  min(analysis_data$urban_density, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(analysis_data$urban_density, na.rm = TRUE),
  length.out = 200
)

# hold diversity at mean
d_mean <- mean(analysis_data$D_z, na.rm = TRUE)

pred_data <- data.frame(
  urban_density = x_seq,
  D_z = d_mean
)


coef(model_nonlinear)
b <- coef(model_nonlinear)

b1 <- b["PC1"]
b2 <- b["I(I(PC1^2))"]
b3 <- b["PC2"]

pred_data <- pred_data %>%
  mutate(
    yhat = b1 * urban_density +
           b2 * urban_density^2 +
           b3 * D_z
  )


ggplot(pred_data, aes(x = urban_density, y = yhat)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Urban Density (standardized)",
    y = "Predicted Cost Burden",
    title = "Convex Relationship Between Urban Density and Cost Burden",
    subtitle = "Holding industrial diversity at mean"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

pred_data <- pred_data %>%
  mutate(
    marginal_effect = b1 + 2 * b2 * urban_density
  )

ggplot(pred_data, aes(x = urban_density, y = marginal_effect)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "Urban Density",
    y = "Marginal Effect on Cost Burden",
    title = "Increasing Marginal Effect of Urban Density on Cost Burden"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


x_seq <- seq(
  min(analysis_data$PC1, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(analysis_data$PC1, na.rm = TRUE),
  length.out = 200
)

pred_data <- data.frame(
  PC1 = x_seq,
  PC2 = mean(analysis_data$PC2, na.rm = TRUE)
)

pred_data <- pred_data %>%
  mutate(
    GEOID = analysis_data$GEOID[1],
    year = analysis_data$year[1]
  )

pred <- predict(
  model_nonlinear,
  newdata = pred_data,
  fixef = FALSE
)


X <- model.matrix(
  ~ PC1 + I(PC1^2) + PC2,
  data = pred_data
)

b <- coef(model_nonlinear)
b
X <- model.matrix(~ PC1 + I(PC1^2) + PC2, data = pred_data)
colnames(X)[colnames(X) == "I(PC1^2)"] <- "I(I(PC1^2))"
colnames(X)
names(b)
X <- X[, names(b), drop = FALSE]
pred_data$yhat <- as.numeric(X %*% b)
vc <- vcov(model_nonlinear)

pred_data$se <- sqrt(diag(X %*% vc %*% t(X)))

pred_data <- pred_data %>%
  mutate(
    ci_lower = yhat - 1.96 * se,
    ci_upper = yhat + 1.96 * se
  )
```

```{r Step 4: Marginal Effects Plot, include=TRUE}
b <- coef(model_nonlinear)
vc <- vcov(model_nonlinear)

b1 <- b["PC1"]
b2 <- b["I(I(PC1^2))"]

pc1_seq <- seq(
  min(analysis_data$PC1, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(analysis_data$PC1, na.rm = TRUE),
  length.out = 200
)

me <- b1 + 2 * b2 * pc1_seq


G <- cbind(
  PC1 = 1,
  `I(I(PC1^2))` = 2 * pc1_seq,
  PC2 = 0
)

vc_sub <- vc[names(b), names(b)]

me_se <- sqrt(rowSums((G %*% vc_sub) * G))

plot_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pc1_seq,
  me = me,
  se = me_se,
  ci_lower = me - 1.96 * me_se,
  ci_upper = me + 1.96 * me_se
)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = PC1, y = me)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Urban Intensity (PC1)",
    y = "Marginal Effect of PC1 on Cost Burden",
    title = "Increasing Marginal Effects of Urban Intensity",
    subtitle = "Fixed-effects quadratic model with 95% confidence band"
  )
```

```{r Step 5: Two Panel Plot Setup, include=TRUE}
library(patchwork)
b  <- coef(model_nonlinear)
vc <- vcov(model_nonlinear)

b1 <- b["PC1"]
b2 <- b["I(I(PC1^2))"]

pc1_seq <- seq(
  min(analysis_data$PC1, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(analysis_data$PC1, na.rm = TRUE),
  length.out = 200
)

pred_level <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pc1_seq,
  PC2 = mean(analysis_data$PC2, na.rm = TRUE)
)

# design matrix (must match model terms exactly)
X_level <- model.matrix(~ PC1 + I(PC1^2) + PC2 - 1, data = pred_level)
colnames(X_level)[colnames(X_level) == "I(PC1^2)"] <- "I(I(PC1^2))"
X_level <- X_level[, names(b), drop = FALSE]

pred_level$yhat <- as.numeric(X_level %*% b)

pred_level$se <- sqrt(diag(X_level %*% vc %*% t(X_level)))

pred_level <- pred_level %>%
  mutate(
    ci_lower = yhat - 1.96 * se,
    ci_upper = yhat + 1.96 * se
  )

me <- b1 + 2 * b2 * pc1_seq

G <- cbind(
  PC1 = 1,
  `I(I(PC1^2))` = 2 * pc1_seq,
  PC2 = 0
)

vc_sub <- vc[names(b), names(b)]

me_se <- sqrt(rowSums((G %*% vc_sub) * G))

pred_me <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pc1_seq,
  me = me,
  ci_lower = me - 1.96 * me_se,
  ci_upper = me + 1.96 * me_se
)


p1 <- ggplot(pred_level, aes(x = PC1, y = yhat)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "A. Effect of Urban Intensity on Cost Burden",
    x = "Urban Intensity (PC1)",
    y = "Predicted Cost Burden"
  )

p2 <- ggplot(pred_me, aes(x = PC1, y = me)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "B. Marginal Effect of Urban Intensity",
    x = "Urban Intensity (PC1)",
    y = "dy/dPC1"
  )

final_plot <- p1 / p2 + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1))

final_plot

b <- coef(model_nonlinear)

b1 <- b["PC1"]
b2 <- b["I(I(PC1^2))"]

turning_point <- -b1 / (2 * b2)
turning_point

p1 <- p1 +
  geom_vline(xintercept = turning_point, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = turning_point,
    y = Inf,
    label = "Turning point",
    vjust = 2,
    size = 3
  )

p2 <- p2 +
  geom_vline(xintercept = turning_point, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = turning_point,
    y = max(pred_me$me, na.rm = TRUE),
    label = "Turning point",
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 3
  )

final_plot <- p1 / p2 +
  patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1))

final_plot
```

```{r Step 6: Non-PCA Approach, include=TRUE}
#First Clean Fixed Effects Model
model_substantive <- feols(
  cost_burdened ~ 
    log_housing_density +
    employment_density_z +
    industry_diversity +
    log_housing_density:employment_density_z |
    GEOID + year,
  data = analysis_data
)

summary(model_substantive)

#Nonlinear Model
model_substantive_nl <- feols(
  cost_burdened ~ 
    log_housing_density +
    I(log_housing_density^2) +
    employment_density_z +
    industry_diversity |
    GEOID + year,
  data = analysis_data
)

summary(model_substantive_nl)

model_substantive_fit <- feols(cost_burdened ~ 
  log_housing_density +
  I(log_housing_density^2) +
  employment_density_z +
  log_housing_density:employment_density_z +
  industry_diversity |
  GEOID + year,
  data = analysis_data)

summary(model_substantive_fit)
```

```{r Step 7: Plot Non PCA Approach, include=TRUE}
b <- coef(model_substantive_nl)
vc <- vcov(model_substantive_nl)

h_seq <- seq(
  min(analysis_data$log_housing_density, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(analysis_data$log_housing_density, na.rm = TRUE),
  length.out = 200
)

pred_h <- data.frame(
  log_housing_density = h_seq,
  employment_density_z = mean(analysis_data$employment_density_z, na.rm = TRUE),
  industry_diversity = mean(analysis_data$industry_diversity, na.rm = TRUE)
)

X_h <- model.matrix(
  ~ log_housing_density + I(log_housing_density^2) +
    employment_density_z + industry_diversity - 1,
  data = pred_h
)

colnames(X_h)
names(b)

colnames(X_h)[colnames(X_h) == "I(log_housing_density^2)"] <- "I(I(log_housing_density^2))"

pred_h$yhat <- as.numeric(X_h %*% b)
pred_h$se <- sqrt(diag(X_h %*% vc %*% t(X_h)))


e_seq <- seq(
  min(analysis_data$employment_density_z, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(analysis_data$employment_density_z, na.rm = TRUE),
  length.out = 200
)

pred_e <- data.frame(
  log_housing_density = mean(analysis_data$log_housing_density, na.rm = TRUE),
  employment_density_z = e_seq,
  industry_diversity = mean(analysis_data$industry_diversity, na.rm = TRUE)
)

X_e <- model.matrix(
  ~ log_housing_density + I(log_housing_density^2) +
    employment_density_z + industry_diversity - 1,
  data = pred_e
)

colnames(X_e)[colnames(X_e) == "I(log_housing_density^2)"] <- "I(I(log_housing_density^2))"

X_e <- X_e[, names(b), drop = FALSE]

pred_e$yhat <- as.numeric(X_e %*% b)

pred_e$se <- sqrt(diag(X_e %*% vc %*% t(X_e)))


d_seq <- seq(
  min(analysis_data$industry_diversity, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(analysis_data$industry_diversity, na.rm = TRUE),
  length.out = 200
)

pred_d <- data.frame(
  log_housing_density = mean(analysis_data$log_housing_density, na.rm = TRUE),
  employment_density_z = mean(analysis_data$employment_density_z, na.rm = TRUE),
  industry_diversity = d_seq
)

X_d <- model.matrix(
  ~ log_housing_density + I(log_housing_density^2) +
    employment_density_z + industry_diversity - 1,
  data = pred_d
)

colnames(X_d)[colnames(X_d) == "I(log_housing_density^2)"] <- "I(I(log_housing_density^2))"

X_d <- X_d[, names(b), drop = FALSE]

pred_d$yhat <- as.numeric(X_d %*% b)

pred_d$se <- sqrt(diag(X_d %*% vc %*% t(X_d)))


base_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11)
  )

p1 <- ggplot(pred_h, aes(x = log_housing_density, y = yhat)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = yhat - 1.96 * se,
                  ymax = yhat + 1.96 * se),
              alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "A. Housing Pressure (Nonlinear)",
    x = "Log Housing Density",
    y = "Predicted Cost Burden"
  ) +
  base_theme

p2 <- ggplot(pred_e, aes(x = employment_density_z, y = yhat)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = yhat - 1.96 * se,
                  ymax = yhat + 1.96 * se),
              alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "B. Employment Density (Weak Direct Effect)",
    x = "Employment Density (z-score)",
    y = "Predicted Cost Burden"
  ) +
  base_theme

p3 <- ggplot(pred_d, aes(x = industry_diversity, y = yhat)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = yhat - 1.96 * se,
                  ymax = yhat + 1.96 * se),
              alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "C. Industry Diversity (Structural Effect)",
    x = "Industry Diversity (1 − HHI)",
    y = "Predicted Cost Burden"
  ) +
  base_theme

ymin <- min(
  pred_h$yhat - 1.96 * pred_h$se,
  pred_e$yhat - 1.96 * pred_e$se,
  pred_d$yhat - 1.96 * pred_d$se
)

ymax <- max(
  pred_h$yhat + 1.96 * pred_h$se,
  pred_e$yhat + 1.96 * pred_e$se,
  pred_d$yhat + 1.96 * pred_d$se
)

p1 <- p1 + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(ymin, ymax))
p2 <- p2 + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(ymin, ymax))
p3 <- p3 + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(ymin, ymax))

final_figure <- p1 | p2 | p3 +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Urban Cost Burden: Three Structural Channels",
    subtitle = "Fixed effects model with nonlinear housing dynamics and structural composition effects"
  )

final_figure

ggsave("figures.png", plot = final_figure, 
       width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r Step 8: Newer Heatmap Plot, include=TRUE}
b <- coef(model_substantive_fit)

h_seq <- seq(
  min(analysis_data$log_housing_density, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(analysis_data$log_housing_density, na.rm = TRUE),
  length.out = 100
)

e_seq <- seq(
  min(analysis_data$employment_density_z, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(analysis_data$employment_density_z, na.rm = TRUE),
  length.out = 100
)

grid <- expand.grid(
  log_housing_density = h_seq,
  employment_density_z = e_seq
)

# hold diversity constant
grid$industry_diversity <- mean(analysis_data$industry_diversity, na.rm = TRUE)

X <- model.matrix(
  ~ log_housing_density +
    I(log_housing_density^2) +
    employment_density_z +
    industry_diversity +
    log_housing_density:employment_density_z - 1,
  data = grid
)

colnames(X)[colnames(X) == "I(log_housing_density^2)"] <- "I(I(log_housing_density^2))"

X <- X[, names(b), drop = FALSE]

grid$yhat <- as.numeric(X %*% b)

b1 <- b["log_housing_density"]
b2 <- b["I(I(log_housing_density^2))"]

h_star <- -b1 / (2 * b2)

bE  <- b["employment_density_z"]
bHE <- b["log_housing_density:employment_density_z"]

# function for line
flip_line <- function(h) {
  -bE / bHE
}

p <- ggplot(grid, aes(x = log_housing_density,
                      y = employment_density_z,
                      fill = yhat)) +
  geom_tile() +
  
  # color scale
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Predicted\nCost Burden") +
  
  # housing turning point (vertical)
  geom_vline(xintercept = h_star,
             linetype = "dashed",
             linewidth = 1) +
  
  # employment flip (horizontal)
  geom_hline(yintercept = flip_line(0),
             linetype = "dotted",
             linewidth = 1) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Agglomeration and Cost Burden: Interaction Surface",
    subtitle = "Housing density (nonlinear) × Employment density interaction",
    x = "Log Housing Density",
    y = "Employment Density (z-score)"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

p

p <- p +
  annotate("text",
           x = min(h_seq), y = max(e_seq),
           label = "Jobs reduce burden",
           hjust = 0, size = 3.5) +
  
  annotate("text",
           x = max(h_seq), y = max(e_seq),
           label = "High-cost agglomeration",
           hjust = 1, size = 3.5) +
  
  annotate("text",
           x = min(h_seq), y = min(e_seq),
           label = "Low-density affordability",
           hjust = 0, size = 3.5)

p

p_contour <- ggplot(grid, aes(

  )

analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(metro_clean = case_when(
    grepl("New York", NAME) ~ "New York",
    
    grepl("San Francisco|San Jose|Oakland", NAME) ~ "San Francisco Bay Area",
    
    grepl("Los Angeles", NAME) ~ "Los Angeles",
    
    grepl("Boston", NAME) ~ "Boston",
    
    grepl("Chicago", NAME) ~ "Chicago",
    
    grepl("Washington", NAME) & grepl("DC|D.C|District of Columbia", NAME) ~ "Washington, DC",
    
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

key_metros <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(metro_clean)) %>%
  group_by(metro_clean) %>%
  summarise(
    log_housing_density = mean(log_housing_density, na.rm = TRUE),
    employment_density_z = mean(employment_density_z, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

key_metros <- key_metros %>%
  mutate(label = metro_clean)

p_pub_labeled <- p_contour +
  
  # points for key metros
  geom_point(
    data = key_metros,
    aes(x = log_housing_density,
        y = employment_density_z),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 2.2,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  # text labels (repelled to avoid overlap)
  geom_text_repel(
    data = key_metros,
    aes(x = log_housing_density,
        y = employment_density_z,
        label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    segment.color = "grey40",
    max.overlaps = Inf
  )

p_pub_labeled

ggsave("contourplot.png", plot = p_pub_labeled, 
       width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
